trigger: After cleaning, to reduce future clogs
steps: Clean the gutters thoroughly before installing guards.
Measure gutter length and choose a guard type (mesh, foam, reverse-curve).
Cut guard sections to length with tin snips.
Snap or screw guards into place along the gutter's outer and inner lip.
Test with a hose to confirm water still flows into the gutter, not over it.
